_comment: Prefab model library. Every model is assembled from primitives + curves by library.place. offsets/points are meters, rotations radians, origin = ground centre, +Z up.

campfire.description: Stone-ring campfire: 3 crossed logs, glowing embers and 19 curved, tapered flame tongues in 3 layers (deep red-orange outside, orange in the middle, yellow core) plus a warm orange point light.

torch.description: Hand torch: wooden stick, cloth wrap, 4 curved flame tongues and a warm point light.

lantern.description: Glowing lantern: base, cap, emissive glass, curved bezier handle and a warm point light.

pine_tree.description: Low-poly pine tree: trunk plus 3 stacked cones (about 4.3 m tall).

round_tree.description: Round-canopy tree: trunk, two tapered curved branches and 4 overlapping foliage blobs (about 3.7 m tall).

bush.description: Low-poly bush made of 3 overlapping blobs.

rock.description: Boulder: a large flattened rock with a smaller one leaning on it.

log_seat.description: Lying log you can sit on (about 1.4 m long).

stool.description: Folding camp stool: blue seat and 4 thin metal legs.

tent.description: A-frame camping tent made of real flat panels: blue/green slopes, two closed triangular ends and a floor, with two guy ropes (curves) and stakes. Sits flat on the ground, no ground plane needed.

fence.description: 2 m wooden fence segment (3 posts, 2 rails). Place several side by side to make a longer fence.

street_lamp.description: Street lamp: pole, curved bezier arm, glowing bulb and a warm-white point light (about 3.9 m tall).

cloud.description: Puffy cloud made of 4 overlapping spheres. Place it high (z around 8-10) for a sky.

palm_tree.description: Palm tree: tall gently curved tapered trunk, 8 drooping leaf fronds and coconuts (about 7 m tall).

park_bench.description: Park bench: wooden seat and back slats on a dark cast-iron frame with armrests (1.8 m long, 0.85 m tall). Faces -Y; turn it with yaw_degrees.

cricket_wicket.description: Cricket wicket: three 71 cm stumps with two bails resting ON TOP. A pitch has one at each end, 20.12 m apart, both in the middle of the 3 m pitch strip.

stadium_light.description: Stadium floodlight mast (about 21 m): concrete base, steel mast, a tilted frame with 12 glowing lamps and a strong wide spot light. Faces +Y and points down at the field - place it outside the boundary with face_towards=[field centre].

football_goal.description: Football (soccer) goal: 7.32 x 2.44 m white posts and crossbar with a net sloping back 2 m. The mouth faces -Y; place it on the goal line with face_towards the pitch centre.

badminton_net.description: Badminton net: two 1.55 m posts on the doubles side lines (6.10 m apart), 0.76 m deep net with a white top tape at 1.55 m. Runs along Y - place it at the court centre (net_centre from mesh.field_markings badminton).

tennis_net.description: Tennis net: two 1.07 m posts 0.914 m outside the doubles side lines (12.80 m apart), 1 m deep net with a white top band. Runs along Y - place it at the court centre.

volleyball_net.description: Volleyball net: two 2.55 m posts 1 m outside the side lines, 1 m deep net with its top at 2.43 m, white top band and antennas. Runs along Y - place it at the court centre.

basketball_hoop.description: Basketball hoop: pole and base behind the baseline, arm, 1.80 x 1.05 m glass backboard 2.2 m in front of the pole (1.2 m inside the baseline when the pole stands 1 m behind it), orange rim 3.05 m high with a net. Front is +Y: place it at hoop_pole_spots from mesh.field_markings basketball with face_towards the court centre.

badminton_racket.description: Badminton racket (66.5 cm) lying flat on the floor: grip, thin shaft, oval head frame with white strings. Origin at the end of the grip; the head points to +X.

shuttlecock.description: Shuttlecock: rounded cork base with a white feather skirt (8.8 cm), standing on its cork.

bicycle.description: Bicycle (1.75 m long): red diamond frame, black tyres with rims and spokes, saddle and handlebar, standing upright on both wheels. Front wheel points +X.

bicycle_parking.description: Covered bicycle parking (9.2 x 3.2 m): concrete pad, sloped metal shelter roof on 4 posts, 6 steel hoop stands and 5 parked bicycles. Bikes are parked along Y; the open side faces -Y.

bed.description: Single bed 2.0 x 0.95 m: wooden frame and headboard (at -X), mattress and pillow.

study_table.description: Study table / desk 1.2 x 0.6 m, 76 cm high, with a drawer unit on the right. The user sits at -Y.

chair.description: Wooden chair (seat 45 cm high) with a back rest at +Y; it faces -Y.

wardrobe.description: Two-door wooden wardrobe / almirah 1.0 x 0.6 x 2.0 m with metal handles; doors face -Y.

ceiling_fan.description: Ceiling fan with 3 blades (1.3 m across). Its origin is the ceiling mount: place it at the ceiling height (e.g. z = 3.0), it hangs 56 cm down.

table_tennis_table.description: Regulation table-tennis (ping pong) table 2.74 x 1.525 m, top at 76 cm: dark green top with white lines, metal legs and a net across the middle.

dining_table.description: Dining table 2.0 x 0.9 m with 6 chairs (3 on each long side) - one call per table in a mess / dining hall / restaurant.

sofa.description: Three-seat fabric sofa 2.0 m with arm rests; back at +Y, it faces -Y.

bookshelf.description: Library bookshelf 2.0 x 0.4 x 2.0 m, 5 shelves full of books; open side faces -Y.

reception_desk.description: L-shaped reception / security desk 4.4 m wide, 1.1 m high, wooden body with a light top. Visitors stand at -Y.

double_bed.description: King-size double bed 1.9 x 2.1 m: wooden base on brass legs, tall upholstered headboard at +Y, mattress, duvet, a throw and two pillows. The foot (front) faces -Y.

nightstand.description: Bedside table / nightstand 0.5 x 0.42 x 0.58 m with two drawers and brass handles; drawers face -Y. Put a table_lamp on top (location z = 0.58).

table_lamp.description: Bedside / desk table lamp 0.55 m tall: brass base and stem, cream fabric shade and a warm light. Put it ON a nightstand or desk (location z = top of that furniture).

pendant_light.description: Ceiling pendant lamp: canopy, 0.6 m cord, brass dome shade and a glowing bulb with a warm light. Its origin is the CEILING mount: place it at the ceiling height (location z = ceiling), it hangs down 0.85 m.

chandelier.description: Luxury brass chandelier 0.95 m wide: ring of 8 candle bulbs, hanging crystals and a warm light. Its origin is the CEILING mount: place it at ceiling height (location z = ceiling).

floor_lamp.description: Standing floor lamp 1.65 m: round base, thin pole and a fabric drum shade with a warm light. Put it in a corner or beside a sofa / armchair.

rug.description: Area rug / carpet 2.6 x 1.8 m with a border; lies flat on the floor (put it under the bed foot, sofa or coffee table).

wall_art.description: Framed painting / wall art 1.2 x 0.8 m with a gold frame; the picture faces -Y. HANGS ON A WALL: location = the centre of its back at eye height (z about 1.5-1.7 m), touching the wall's inner face; face_towards the room centre.

potted_plant.description: Indoor potted plant 1.4 m: ceramic pot and a leafy crown. Put it in a room corner or beside furniture.

armchair.description: Upholstered armchair / accent chair 0.9 m wide: seat, back at +Y, two arms and wooden legs; it faces -Y.

coffee_table.description: Coffee / centre table 1.1 x 0.6 m, 42 cm high: marble-look top on brass legs with a lower shelf. Put it in front of a sofa.

tv_unit.description: TV unit: low wooden cabinet 1.8 x 0.45 m with a 55-inch flat TV on a stand; the screen faces -Y. Put it against a wall, facing the sofa or bed.

curtains.description: Curtains: a brass rod 2.5 m wide with two pleated drapes pulled to the sides (2.45 m long), for a window or a wall. Place it 0.1 m in front of the wall, centred on the window.

mirror.description: Tall standing / wall mirror 0.8 x 1.6 m with a brass frame; the glass faces -Y.
